en.text:
Grants 625% Additional Base Melee Recharge Rate while Proximity Knife remains unexploded.

<solar/>Proximity Explosive Knife applies 60 <solar/>Scorch on detonation. (Unaffected by <solar/>Ember of Ashes). Proximity Explosive Knife kills trigger an <solar/>Ignition.

<solar/>Ignition kills (on any subclass) grant a full Melee Ability Charge. This can overflow into one additional <solar/>Solar Knife charge (any knife) or one additional <stasis/>Withering Blade charge beyond capacity.

On Prismatic, this can overflow into two additional <solar/>Knife Tricks or <stasis/>Withering Blades beyond capacity.

<solar/>Scorch grants 7% Melee Ability Energy per tick. (Due to chunk ability scaling, this grants ~5% energy to Proximity Knife).
